recent.text: FINAL: Heat 108, Knicks 105 - Adebayo 25pts/7reb/2blk - Antetokounmpo 22pts/23reb/3ast - Mitchell 12pts/9ast - Larsson 11pts/3reb The Heat are now 11-7 on the season. They play next in Cleveland on Sunday.
recent.author: Eric Nehm

recent.text: And Miami escapes with a 108-105 win. Heat ran the exact same play as they did when they needed to inbound the first time. Pelle Larsson got it back this time from Davion Mitchell for a dunk. Jalen Brunson tried to draw a foul on the drive back down. But missed the game-tying 3
recent.author: Eric Nehm

recent.quoted_text: Interesting challenge here from Erik Spoelstra. The upside is there as it would take three free-throw attempts away from the Knicks, but it's a tough bit of physicality to untangle. Myron Gardner did make contact with Jose Alvarado, but Mo Diawara might have affected Gardner.

recent.text: Out of the timeout, Miami has gone to Bam Adebayo on the block twice. And he's drawn a foul on Karl-Anthony Towns on both plays. Only made 2 of 4 from the line, but that had to be the exact aggression Erik Spoelstra was looking for out of Adebayo.
